concerns.location: plan.md:Section 'Statistical Modeling' (line ~70) – "compute VIF, perform 5 000 Freedman‑Lane permutations..." and Risks & Mitigations (line ~150) – "The verified fact `VIF = 33` exceeds the `< 5` threshold. The pipeline will compute VIF, report the high value, and flag multicollinearity in the PDF (SC‑005 satisfied because the metric is measured)."
concerns.text: The plan claims that Success Criterion SC‑005 (VIF < 5) will be satisfied, yet it also states a verified fact that the VIF equals 33, which violates the threshold. This makes the claim that the analysis will meet SC‑005 false by definition, rendering the scientific validation of the model impossible under the stated criteria. The plan must either adjust the success criterion, modify the predictor set to achieve VIF < 5, or acknowledge that the criterion cannot be met.
